newsitem.title: CANADA: Union begins strike at GM Canada unit.
newsitem.headline: Union begins strike at GM Canada unit.

text.p: Canadian Auto Workers (CAW) union president Buzz Hargrove said the union began a strike against General Motors Corp's Canadian subsidiary less than two hours before a strike deadline.
Hargrove said some of the union's workers went on a strike while the company was delivering a last minute economic package, which it had promised the union yesterday.
"So we are on strike," Hargrove said. "Our plants are down." He said GM's last minute economic offer was an insult to the union and a "total joke."
